provenance_caveat: Hyperliquid public-API PARTIAL window (aligned 2026-04-20T03:00:00Z..2026-09-28T23:00:00Z, 24 complete symbols x 3885 bars). NOT the 283-day spec window and NOT performance evidence.

episode_audit.finding: The partial window produced zero confirmed rebound signals and therefore zero trades. There are no crash episodes to cluster, no distinct crash days, and no episode-level PnL to bootstrap. The episode-aware audit is vacuous on this data: it can neither support nor refute an edge.

temporal_edge_permutation.reason: Permutation requires a canonical trade set to sit at a percentile of the null distribution. With zero trades there is no canonical PnL and no admissible draw. Running it would manufacture a p-value from an empty trade set, which is exactly the per-event-null-as-portfolio-test prohibition; it is recorded as NOT RUN rather than reported as a significant or non-significant result.

limitations: Zero-signal partial window; the rare-event strategy simply did not fire in 3885 bars x 24 symbols.
The 11 RSI(21)<20 census events did not convert to confirmed signals under the spec gates (volume, bounce, regime/price, one-position-per-coin).
This is a pipeline and power-reality check, not evidence about strategy profitability on Hyperliquid.
A longer Hyperliquid-native history is required before any episode-aware inference is possible.
